commands.name: manifest JSON validity
commands.run: for f in suite.repos.json .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plugins/suite-kit/.claude-plugin/plugin.json .claude/suite.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done

commands.name: suite-kit version match
commands.run: python3 -c "import json; a=json.load(open('.claude-plugin/marketplace.json'))['plugins'][0]['version']; b=json.load(open('plugins/suite-kit/.claude-plugin/plugin.json'))['version']; exit(0 if a==b else 1)"
